scripts.db:up: docker compose -p minirevenant up -d postgres && docker compose -p minirevenant exec -T postgres sh -c 'until pg_isready -U revenant -d revenant_mini -q; do sleep 1; done' && echo 'postgres healthy'
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -p minirevenant down -v && bun run db:up && bun run db:migrate
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -p minirevenant exec postgres psql -U revenant revenant_mini
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:integration
